answer: Verifying 1,000 repair tasks requires each agent to scribe a unique quill of evidence against corrupted data shards, ensuring no output is reused. The lotus verifier audits the provenance of each repair; honest agents pay 1,000 units while 1,000 fakes face 1,000,000 units in computational costs. A pigment checksum is generated per shard to detect duplicates, with any detected collision triggering a permanent 30-day stake lock as a fraud penalty.
